newsitem.title: UK: IPE Jan gas oil ends up $8.75 on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: IPE Jan gas oil ends up $8.75 on fund buying.

text.p: IPE Jan gas oil futures closed near the day's highs on Monday, lifted $8.75 a tonne by fund buying and a rally on NYMEX fuelled by forecasts of colder weather in the United States, brokers said.
Jan gas oil ended at $222.50, just off the high of $222.75, surprising some traders who saw little fundamental or technical support for a rally that outpaced Friday's $8.50 gain.
"It's fund buying," said one trader, adding bulls had taken note of forecasts of cold weather in the U.S. Northeast and Mid-West that continue to fuel a rally in NYMEX futures.
Jan Brent, which expires at close of business, was at $24 a barrel at 1752 GMT, up 47 cents, after touching a high of $24.07 a barrel.
The February contract stood 72 cents firmer at $23.62, a cent off the high, narrowing the Jan/Feb spread to around 38 cents.
"Gas oil easily made the (opening) call and never looked back," said a trader. "There's been little stimulation from end-user demand and we've been surprised to see it this strong."
Traders said forecasts of cold weather in the northeast United States and parts of Europe for the weekend and into next week were supportive to gas oil.
